syllabus_topics: History and context of the OO paradigm
SAX and DOM tools for XML file analysis
assessment_rules: The final grade for the normal, resit, and special exam periods, as well as for worker-students, is calculated as 50% from the exam and 50% from continuous assessment. Continuous assessment comprises a project (40%) with a 30-minute oral discussion and labs (10%). For worker-students and special period students who did not complete labs, the project accounts for 50% of the continuous assessment. Fraud, including copying or unauthorized use of information in any assessment work, leads to the annulment of the work for all involved.
bibliography: Grady Booch, James Rumbaugh, Ivar Jacobson, The Unified Modeling Language User Guide, Addison-Wesley, 1999 (main)
Mr Kotiyana, Java The Complete Core Reference, 11th Edition (The Complete Reference), 2019 (main)
